_comment: Synthetic test scenarios only — NOT live Booking.com observations. http_status is replayed by the offline fetch path so HTTP-authoritative states can be exercised without a network request.

available.description: Two ordinary room rows with observed selector maxima (2 and 3).

sold_out.description: One row whose selector offers only 0 (sold_out) plus one ordinary row.

no_rooms.description: Property page chrome with zero room rows -> no_rooms_listed.

waf_challenge.description: Observed WAF markers, empty title, HTTP 202 -> stop, never bypass.

captcha.description: Visible text + widget markup + challenge title -> stop.

http_denied.description: HTTP 403 is authoritative on its own -> stop, no retries.

property_mismatch.description: Clean room table for a different property -> identity check refuses to scrape.

structure_changed.description: Room row with no readable name -> error row, no retry.
